why_a_second_split: Held-out split v1 (protocol.json) was run once and its failures were inspected: 8/11 false negatives were the stacked layout (recipient on the line below its label). The payee extractor was then extended for stacked layouts. v1 results remain the official pre-fix measurement and are not re-run. v2 measures the fixed pipeline on data no-one has seen.

independence.fonts_note: not used in dev, v1 test, or the earlier threshold calibration
independence.recipient_names: list C, disjoint from A (dev) and B (v1 test)
independence.caveat: Same generator family and layouts as v1; the stacked-layout fix was designed after seeing v1 failures, so v2 is independent data but not an independent design.

run_policy: Run once; the script refuses to overwrite test2 results or to run if the config hash changes.
